comment: The goblin camp, a developer zone (docs/world.md): only admins go in, from the Admin menu, each party into a copy of its own. A war-band of goblins (content/creatures/goblin/) stands round its fire at the north end, to fight or to watch working together: they spot you, close in turns, circle, stab, throw and drink when hurt (crates/engine/src/pack.rs). An open arena in a space of its own (content/instances/goblinsDread.json says how). `door` is where its way out lets you out in the world. Heights (top) are above its origin.
name: The Goblin Camp
about: A war-band of goblins round their fire, to fight or to watch working together: they spot you, take turns to close in, circle, stab, throw and drink when hurt.
